svg.title: Ananya starts the analyser as a nearby biometric scanner rejects a patient.
svg.desc: Ananya gives the repaired analyser its exact activating tap while Riju adds a field for the triage reason. At the other end of the panel, a biometric scanner rejects the next patient's hand.
svg.text: Page 11, panel 5 · Wide lateral shot from the diagnostic bench to the check-in scanner

text.tspan: Ananya's analyser starts, Riju records the triage
reason, and the next check-in immediately fails.
